_note: ElevenLabs Sound Effects prompts. Each renders to sfx/<name>.wav; the mixer prefers these files over the procedural versions in engine/sfx.py.

impact.text: Deep cinematic trailer impact hit, huge sub boom with a sharp transient crack and a long dark reverb tail, no music

hit_metal.text: Elegant metallic cinematic hit, polished steel shimmer ring with a soft low thud, luxury title reveal, clean tail

whoosh.text: Fast smooth air whoosh pass-by for a video transition, clean, no tonal content

swish.text: Very short tight swish for a quick cut, subtle and crisp

riser.text: Tense cinematic riser building to a drop, rising filtered noise and pitch, ends abruptly at the peak

reverse_swell.text: Reverse cymbal and reverb swell sucking in toward a hit, dark and smooth

sub_drop.text: Sub bass drop, deep pitch falling boom, clean low end

heartbeat.text: Single slow human heartbeat, lub-dub, very low and close, dry, in silence

tick.text: Tiny digital UI tick for on-screen text typing, very short and soft

click_soft.text: Soft mechanical keyboard key press, single click, close microphone

glitch.text: Short digital glitch stutter, data corruption bleeps and bit crushed noise burst

shutter.text: Camera shutter click, single frame, crisp

shimmer.text: Delicate magical sparkle shimmer, high glassy twinkle, soft and elegant

boom_low.text: Massive low cinematic boom for a logo reveal, warm deep resonance and long natural decay, no high-pitched elements
